title: Security
twoFactorAuthDesc: TOTP codes and backup codes, asked after the password and accepted for 5 minutes; a wrong code counts as a failed sign-in
jwtAuthenticationDesc: Token-based authentication for Console API requests
s3SignatureDesc: AWS-compatible signature authentication for S3 API
bcryptPasswordDesc: Industry-standard password hashing with per-user salt
rateLimitingDesc: {{count}} sign-in attempts per minute per IP address, two-factor codes included, counted on each node
accountLockoutDesc: Locked for {{duration}} after {{attempts}} failed sign-ins, wrong passwords and two-factor codes alike. In a cluster each node counts its own; an unlock reaches every node
sessionManagementDesc: The console signs out after {{idle}} without activity; a refresh token lasts {{duration}}
rbacDesc: Roles, bucket permissions and attached policies are all IAM policies, evaluated AWS-style: default deny, and an explicit Deny always wins
serverSideEncryptionDesc: AES-256-GCM for every stored object, each with its own key wrapped by the KEK kept in the database (authenticated 64 KB chunks)
objectVersioningDesc: Multiple versions with delete markers for data recovery
lifecyclePoliciesDesc: Automated data retention and deletion rules
resourceQuotasDesc: Per tenant: storage, buckets, access keys and a bandwidth cap. Per bucket: size and object count. Writes over a limit are refused; deletes never are
bucketPermissionsDesc: Permissions picked from a catalogue and granted on individual buckets, stored as IAM policies — no document editing
advancedLoggingSystemDesc: HTTP output with batching and Syslog integration (TCP/UDP)
comprehensiveAuditLoggingDesc: 20+ event types tracked with automatic retention ({{days}} days)
bucketNotificationsDesc: Real-time HTTP webhooks for S3 events (ObjectCreated, ObjectRemoved)
prometheusMetricsDesc: Real-time metrics export for monitoring and alerting
emailAlertsDesc: Email for low disk space, tenant and bucket quotas, and objects whose data no longer matches their checksum
dynamicSettingsDesc: Runtime configuration management without server restarts
auditTrailAccessDesc: Complete logging of authentication and access events
readOnlyAuditModeDesc: Global admins can audit tenant buckets without modification
csvExportDesc: Export audit logs for compliance reporting and analysis
bucketPolicyConditionsDesc: Bucket policies evaluated with the IAM policies, AWS-style; conditions on aws:SourceIp and aws:SecureTransport; a policy using other keys or operators is refused when saved
publicAccessBlockEnforcementDesc: All four flags enforced as in AWS: public ACLs and public bucket policies refused when set, or voided for requests without credentials
consoleSecurityHeadersDesc: HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-XSS-Protection and Referrer-Policy on every console response
jwtS3AuthDesc: JWT for the console, where only an access token opens a session; AWS Signature v2/v4 for the S3 API
temporaryCredentialsDesc: Short-lived ASIA keys that project an existing user, with an optional session policy that can only narrow their access. Server-enforced expiry, revocable from the console.
awsIamStsApiDesc: aws sts and aws iam work unmodified against the S3 endpoint. Managing identities needs permanent credentials and the iam:manage permission; a temporary credential cannot mint another.
identityProvidersDesc: Enterprise SSO via LDAP/Active Directory and OAuth2/OIDC (Google, Okta, Keycloak, etc.)
tlsClusterCommDesc: Node-to-node traffic over TLS with the cluster's own CA; every request signed with HMAC-SHA256, with a timestamp and a single-use nonce
maintenanceModeDesc: S3 and console writes refused (503) during maintenance windows; reads and sign-ins keep working
tlsClusterReplicationDesc: An object encrypted with the cluster key is copied as stored, without decrypting it; any other is encrypted again by the receiving node
crossRegionReplicationDesc: Bucket replication to any S3-compatible endpoint, such as AWS S3 or MinIO
storedCredentialEncryptionDesc: Identity provider secrets, replication destination keys and share link keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM, under a secret kept in the database and shared by every node
objectLockVersioningDesc: WORM compliance, versioning with delete markers, lifecycle policies
replicationEndpointProtectionDesc: Destinations that resolve to loopback, private, link-local or cloud metadata addresses are refused, unless replication.allow_internal_endpoints is set
